summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the TuntasUMKM HITL Approval Queue dashboard. All 9 requested feature checks passed: page renders header 'Antrean Persetujuan', stat tiles (pending=4, total=6, completed=1 with Rp 360.000 subtitle), queue lists 6 orders with 4 pending sorted first, click switches live chat + decision card, approve ORD-2406-001 deducts stock 12->11, updates stats (4->3, 1->2), audit records APPROVE_ORDER/DEDUCT_STOCK/NOTIFY_CUSTOMER, chat gets 'sudah dikonfirmasi' bot message, and toast appears. Insufficient stock on ORD-2406-003 (qty 3 vs stock 2) surfaces INSUFFICIENT_STOCK failure alert, stock unchanged, status stays pending. Reject flow on ORD-2406-002 validates empty and <5 char input, preset buttons prefill, cancel returns to Approve/Reject, custom reason confirmed shows order-reject-reason-text, bot chat cancellation message contains the reason, pending decrements. ORD-2406-005 (approved) and 006 (rejected) show no action buttons; 006 renders reject reason. Mobile 390px has zero horizontal overflow. bash scripts/antislop-check.sh exits 0 (ruff + tsc + antislop grep checks all pass).
critical_code_review_comments: ApprovalQueuePage.tsx is clean and delegates to feature components; feature dir stays <200 lines per file - good separation.
State is purely in-memory (useApprovalQueue); acceptable per task spec (mock-only), but any refresh resets. Ensure this expectation is documented for users.

StatSummaryBar exposes value testid only for the count; revenue Rp 360.000 lives in parent tile text as 'note'. If a stricter testid on revenue subtitle is desired, consider a separate data-testid (minor).
seed_data_creation: None - all data is frontend mock (mock-data.ts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend was intentionally skipped (frontend-only task). Preview URL: https://tuntas-hitl-dash.preview.emergentagent.com/. Queue is sorted with pending items first (order in test: 004,003,002,001,005,006). Stat-completed value testid returns only the count '1'; the Rp 360.000 revenue is inside the parent stat-completed-sales tile as subtitle text.
